messages:
Marta (Billing Specialist): Flagging invoice 10012 for HelioHealth  looks like promo CREDIT-APR23 was applied twice, resulting in a negative balance. Can we correct?
Luca (Account Manager): Oh no, customer emailed asking why invoice shows -$1,250. They did redeem a 50% trial promo but only once.
Marta (Billing Specialist): Raw lines: ```
Invoice: 10012
Customer: HelioHealth (EU)
Period: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30
Charges: Service usage: $2,500.00
Promo CREDIT-APR23: -$1,250.00
Promo CREDIT-APR23: -$1,250.00
Total: -$0.00
```
Marta (Billing Specialist): System bug? The promo was supposed to apply only to first invoice for new accounts. This is their second invoice.
Priya (Head of Billing): We need to: 1) communicate to customer, 2) reverse one of the credits and issue a corrected invoice (debit memo), 3) confirm VAT treatment. Any objections to creating a debit memo for $1,250?
Luca (Account Manager): Customer ok with fix as long as we explain and don't charge late fee. I'll preemptively offer to waive any finance fees.
Marta (Billing Specialist): billing-bot, can you show the promo metadata for CREDIT-APR23 and the audit trail for invoice 10012?
billing-bot: Promo CREDIT-APR23: 50% off first invoice, max_uses_per_customer=1, created_by=marketing@redwood.com. Invoice 10012 applied promo twice due to retry on billing webhook. Audit entries: webhook_retry_id=wr-3321 applied promo on 2026-04-01 03:12Z and again on 2026-04-01 03:13Z.
Marta (Billing Specialist): Thanks. We'll need to reverse the extra credit. tax-bot, what's the VAT treatment if we issue a DM for €/USD mix? Customer invoiced in EUR, original invoice used conversion rate 1 EUR = 1.08 USD at billing time.
tax-bot: For EU customers, post-billing adjustments (debit memos) should include VAT where applicable. If the original supply was VAT-exempt? No, platform services are VATable in the customer's EU country. Apply VAT at 20% (HelioHealth based in NL). Debit memo should be EUR-native: amount net = €1,250 / 1.08 = €1,157.41 net, VAT = €231.48, gross = €1,388.89.
Priya (Head of Billing): Approve creation of debit memo up to €1,500. Marta, please create DM and include VAT lines. Also add customer note offering to settle without late fees.
Marta (Billing Specialist): Creating DM now. billing-bot, create DM-2026-078 (customer: HelioHealth) net_eur=1157.41 vat_eur=231.48 gross_eur=1388.89 reason="promo double-apply reversal"
billing-bot: Debit Memo created  DM-2026-078 (status: DRAFT) net: 1157.41 EUR, VAT: 231.48 EUR, gross: 1388.89 EUR. Attachments: none.
Marta (Billing Specialist): Uploading supporting audit: promo_audit_wr-3321.pdf and communication_draft.md
Luca (Account Manager): I'll send the customer-facing message. Draft: "Hi — we found a duplicate promo application due to a billing retry. We've issued a corrected invoice DM-2026-078 for €1,388.89 (incl. VAT). We're not applying any late fees; please reach out if you'd like an alternate payment schedule." OK?
Priya (Head of Billing): Fine. Note: include internal memo that marketing will be notified to fix the promo rule. Also tag RevOps for revenue recognition impact.
Marta (Billing Specialist): billing-bot, move DM-2026-078 to PENDING_APPROVAL and request approver Priya.
billing-bot: DM-2026-078 status -> PENDING_APPROVAL (approver: Priya).
Priya (Head of Billing): Approved. Please ensure revenue adjustment is flagged and GL entries: debit accounts_receivable EUR 1,388.89; credit revenue EUR 1,157.41; credit vat_payable EUR 231.48.
billing-bot: DM-2026-078 moved to APPROVED and posted. Corrected invoice posted as CreditNote 10012-CORR and new invoice DM-2026-078 issued. AR balance updated. Journal entries queued: JE-2026-9901.
Luca (Account Manager): Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick clarification — we'll pay the corrected amount. Appreciated." :thumbsup:
Marta (Billing Specialist): Closing thread. Notifying marketing to patch CREDIT-APR23 rule (ticket MG-2251).
